text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(The start is coming up soon...
I have to nail it... flawlessly!!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Tan"! "Han"! "Men"!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, Danhanmen?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaargh!
There is NO such thing on the menu!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A grievous mistake... Perhaps due to tension,
Rulership suffered a late start out of the gate.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her run afterward turned out
completely different from the plan we had made.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No... way...
This can't be happening...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You gotta be kidding me... It was fine in training.
If this is the opening move, no matter what strategy I come up with...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I'm... done for...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's all over, over, completely overrr.
None of it meant anything at all, did it???

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to this failure, it was clear...
that her tolerance limit had been exceeded.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I said I'd make no mistakes, but like this,
the Satsuki Sho is just totally, hopelessly,
impossibly out of reach...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't nail the start, and I couldn't run the race I wanted at all...
How could this...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be better not to do it at all?
Like, to the point people wonder why she even showed up?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I don't wanna play that kind of game!
That's not fun at all, not one bit!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: If I'm gonna lose anyway!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...I want to execute my strategy perfectly and lose on strategy.
That's what being a gamer is all about...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understood her feelings all too painfully.
After facing what she hated for so long, the frustration of not performing the way she wanted must have been immense.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It's impossible. Competing against them like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho is right around the corner.
In this state of lost confidence...
as frustrating as it is, there's only one answer.
choice_data_list: ...All right. Then let's give up on it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Thank you... And sorry... for dragging you into dealing with someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I can't take it anymore... I hate it, I hate it.
The races, myself, everything.
I just—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I quit, I'm done with all of thiiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For the next few days, Rulership didn't come outside at all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah... what a drag...
Guess I'll just play some casual online matches...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: A railway puzzle game. Maybe I'll play this for the first time in a while.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Place the tracks like this, and like this,
then let the train roll... and done.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And that's a win.
GGs, thx for the match.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Haaah... If only things went as easily as they do in video games.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm, this sound is...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Good grief...
Talk about a blatant trial balloon, but..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's do this. It's not like we were
anything more than board game buddies anyway.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whoa, am I completely surrounded by freight trains on all sides?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"You've really stepped up your game, Trainer.
And—yet."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Have you forgotten? Underground,
there lies an abandoned railway tunnel."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Did you really think I wouldn't notice that?
Coupling! Using the overhead catenary... Power supply engaged!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The Railroad King... is ME!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: WIN ～dominare～

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, well, that should do it.
As long as we're prepared, we can follow up however needed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even when feeling mentally drained, Rulership's strategy still shone brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like before... No, even better than before.
If I can maintain this sharpness...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm, this message is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You can definitely turn things around.
At the Japanese Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘If it's you, you can definitely turn things around.
At the Japanese Derby!’"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby...
choice_data_list: Let's start a NEW GAME together!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: No, but as for me, I'm already...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One last push.
I recall what domi-san—no, what Rulership
has taught me up until now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Among those, the one that lingers most in my heart is...
choice_data_list: Hard mode makes it worthwhile, right!
Hard mode makes it worthwhile, right!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Hard mode...
Just like what I said before..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You're saying this was also one of the pleasures prepared for me...? Trainer, you really are...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Hahaha...
You've learned to talk... quite boldly.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Thinking "if you hit a dead end, it's over"
is the height of folly.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If you hit a wall, find a detour.
It's common sense, really.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Alright—I'll show them my comeback from here.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let us begin our preparations.
For the Nihon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership somehow managed to take a step
out of the swamp of despair.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby...
The distance increases by 400 meters from the Satsuki Sho,
to 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
With the extended distance, the damage from a late start
can be mitigated somewhat. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"There must be a way to break through this.
If I examine every single factor."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"This board—I will read through it completely.
Without fail."
